tagline: AI voice calling platform that confirms cash-on-delivery (COD) orders before dispatch.
coreProblemSolved: Reducing RTO (return-to-origin) and failed deliveries for Indian D2C and e-commerce sellers.
howItWorks: Places automated AI voice calls to customers who placed a cash-on-delivery order, confirming the order details and delivery address before the item is shipped. Catches wrong numbers, changed minds, and incorrect addresses.
